assessment_objectives.objective: authorized Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection activities are documented, including the collecting system or service account, the data sources accessed, the data collected, the destination repository and the collection schedule.
the frequency at which observed Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection activity is reconciled against authorized collection activities is defined.

Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection activity observed in network and Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) logs is reconciled against the documented authorized collection activities at the defined frequency.

collection activity that cannot be reconciled to an authorized Control Assurance Automation (CAA) activity is treated as potential unauthorized data exfiltration and investigated in accordance with incident response procedures.

monitoring and data loss prevention rules are configured to recognize authorized Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection so that alerts distinguish legitimate collection from unauthorized data exfiltration.
